findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 13 in the same format as the Physics 11 chapter practice (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 22 questions numbered 1-22; by section: 13.1 1, 13.3 7, 13.4 4, 13.5 2, 13.6 8.

11 pairs (theory 5 marks + numerical 3 marks) covering Brownian motion and the kinetic-theory assumptions, the force and pressure of one molecule, the derivation of PV = ⅓Nm<v²> and P = ⅓ρ<v²>, P = ⅔N₀<K.E.>, vᵣₘₛ = √(3RT/mN_A), <K.E.> = (3/2)k_BT, the Boltzmann distribution law, neutron stars, the Sun and gravitational pressure, hydrostatic equilibrium and the end stages of stars. Numericals use new values, recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed: rms = √<v²>, P = ⅓ρ<v²> (not PV), P = ⅔N₀<K.E.>, the corrected Examples 13.3/13.4 are not reused, least massive stars live longest, supernova stage.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
